title: The Comedy of Errors: Funny Tales of Mistaken Identities

sentences.text: One day, Tom goes to a party.
The man looks like his friend, Bob.
Tom looks at the other man.
Tom and Bob go to the man.
Tom tells the story to his friends.
Tom learns that mistakes can be good.
He is happy to have new friends.
